## Step 3 — Build locally and open Pull Requests

Complete your assigned feature locally, then stage, commit, and push it.

```bash
git add <your-file>
git commit -m "Describe the feature clearly"
git push -u origin <your-feature-branch>
```

Open one Pull Request from each feature branch into `main`.

Each Pull Request must:

- have a meaningful title;
- contain at least 80 characters of description;
- include sections named **What changed**, **Why**, and **Testing**;
- close the correct feature Issue using its real GitHub number, for example `Closes #7`;
- change only the file owned by that role.

The checker also requires three distinct PR authors working from branches in this same repository, meaningful commit messages, and evidence that at least one commit was made with a normal local Git client rather than only GitHub's web editor.

Do not merge yet. Wait for the Owner's review.
